business_problem: Realizing the need for faster and more agile localization services Founded in 1996, Lionbridge combines the best of human and machine intelligence to support large companies around the world with content creation, content testing, and translation and localization services.
solution_summary: Lionbridge built its solution on Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Translator to automate high-friction work and turn enterprise data into faster decisions. The implementation combines cloud application services, data services, and AI capabilities so business users can search, summarize, analyze, or act on information through a single digital workflow instead of manual handoffs. Since launching its AI-enabled solutions, which use GPT-4 on Azure OpenAI, Lionbridge has reduced project turnaround times by up to 30%. The architecture emphasizes managed services, reusable integrations, and governed data handling so the organization can scale adoption without rebuilding the solution for each new team or use case.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Runs large language model inference for summarization, extraction, conversational AI, and grounded answers.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Foundry
solution_components.role: Provides the managed environment for model orchestration, experimentation, and responsible AI operations.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Translator
solution_components.role: Translates multilingual content and inputs inside the workflow.

solution_components.name: Power Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the low-code automation and application platform for workflow modernization.

data_flow: Content and operational context are prepared in the application data layer, passed to Azure OpenAI for generation or extraction, stored in Azure storage services, and returned through the user-facing application to employees or customers with grounded responses.
